{{nihongo|'''Gosho Shrine'''|御所神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

=== History ===
Its founding is unknown. It stands in a mountainous area of former {{ill|Sadamitsu, Tokushima|Q7397533|qid=Q7397533}}, at a place called Goshohira. It was worshipped by the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Miki clan}}, descendants of the Imbe lineage in this area, and is thought to have been a branch enshrinement of the Engishiki Myojin Taisha Imbe Shrine<ref>Yoneo Okada, "Imbe Shrine / ?asahiko Shrine" (in ''Nihonshi Sh?hyakka <Shrines>'', {{ill|Tōkyōdō Shuppan|Q11524645|qid=Q11524645}}, 1977)</ref>.

It long disputed candidate status for the Engishiki Imbe Shrine with {{ill|Inbe Shrine (Yoshinogawa)|Q11490723|qid=Q11490723|lt=Yamazaki Imbe Shrine}} in {{ill|Yoshinogawa, Tokushima|Q592500|qid=Q592500}}. In {{ill|1881|Q7808|qid=Q7808}} (Meiji 14), this site was fixed as the Imbe shrine site. Yamazaki Imbe Shrine objected, and the {{ill|Dajōkan|Q125768223|qid=Q125768223|lt=Daj?kan}} issued a compromise setting the shrine site at {{ill|Nikenyach?|Q11371805|qid=Q11371805}}, {{ill|Tokushima (city)|Q207309|qid=Q207309}}, while preserving this place as the old site. Later, Gosho Shrine became a sessha of {{ill|Inbe Shrine|Q11490722|qid=Q11490722}} in Tokushima City.

=== Enshrined deity ===

=== Kira Edo-higan cherry tree ===
There is an {{ill|Prunus itosakura|Q51117378|qid=Q51117378}} cherry in front of the shrine, estimated at over 400 years old, selected among the "100 Recommended Viewpoints of Nishi-Awa."

It has a trunk circumference of 4.5m and height about 20m, branching into three major trunks from around 1.5m above ground. It was designated a Tokushima Prefecture natural monument on {{ill|February 23|Q2352|qid=Q2352}}, {{ill|1971|Q2475|qid=Q2475}} (Sh?wa 46)<ref>{{Cite web|??|url=https://www.town.tokushima-tsurugi.lg.jp/docs/3459.html|title=Tokushima Prefecture Designated Natural Monuments|publisher=Tsurugi Town|accessdate=2021-09-14}}</ref>.

=== Access ===
* About 20 minutes by car from {{ill|Sadamitsu Station|Q7397535|qid=Q7397535}} on the {{ill|Tokushima Line|Q899310|qid=Q899310}}.
* About 25 minutes by car from {{ill|Mima interchange|Q11609440|qid=Q11609440}} on the {{ill|Tokushima Expressway|Q11490216|qid=Q11490216}}.
